final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ID AS id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.id AS id, s1.n AS n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.total AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL AND s2.total <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.id, s3.n, s3.r, s3.r - s4.a AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
